records.question: Elvis is releasing a new album with 10 songs, but he doesn't want to waste too much time on writing. He spends 5 hours in the studio, where he writes, records, and edits his songs. Each song takes 12 minutes to record, then it takes 30 minutes to edit all of his songs.   How many minutes did it take Elvis to write each song, if each song took the same amount of time to write?
records.response:
Elvis spent 30 minutes editing his songs.
He also spent 5 hours writing, which is 5*60 = 300 minutes.
In total, Elvis spent 300+30 = 330 minutes writing and recording.
Since he wrote 10 songs, he spent 330/10 = 33 minutes per song writing.
#### 33

Each song takes 12 minutes to record, then it takes 30 minutes to edit all of his songs.   How many minutes did it take Elvis to write each song, if each song took the same amount of time to write?
records.response:
He spent 5 hours x 60 minutes per hour = 300 minutes in the studio.
He spent 300 minutes - 12 minutes per song x 10 songs - 30 minutes = 60 minutes writing songs.
So, it took Elvis 60 minutes / 10 songs = 6 minutes per song to write.

records.question: 50% of substitute teachers walk out after 1 hour of teaching. 30% of the remainder quit before lunch. If 60 substitute teachers show up at 7 AM, how many will be left after lunch?
records.response:
After 1 hour, 50/100 * 60 = 30 substitute teachers leave.
So 60 - 30 = 30 substitute teachers remain.
After lunch, 30/100 * 30 = 9 substitute teachers leave.
So 30 - 9 = 21 substitute teachers remain.
#### 21
